integrity: Exact universal proof included; 225 independent enumerations plus boundary checks. Sources inspected to stated depth; bibliographic uncertainty remains. No independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: One five-voter expert star, independently correct binary signals, identical ordinary competence and signal-independent common delegation rate; no strategic equilibrium or optimality outside this policy family. Prior work already shows that partial delegation can be helpful qualitatively.
title: A sharp two-threshold phase diagram for independent delegation to one expert
